title_o: Testing a hierarchical model of anxiety and depression in adolescents: a tri-level model

replications.quote: The tri-level model fit well in this sample. Furthermore, it fit significantly better than models that eliminated one of the three levels

The trilevel model fit well in this sample and fit better than comparison models that eliminated one of the three levels. Extension analysis successfully integrated interviewer-rating variables into the trilevel model—particularly for the broad and narrow levels.
